text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса didn't show up for
training, so I
decide to go looking for
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Damn, we lost again! It's no fair to
recruit El for
help!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Aerial attacks are a condor's
specialty!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Just keep giving me the ball and I'll
keep droppin'
'em in!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Uh, El... I think your trainer is here...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Qué? What's up, Тренер? You need help
with
somethin'?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! I totally spaced!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I was only gonna play for a little bit, but
my
competitive spirit got the best of
me...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'll be careful next time. I'm really sorry...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
